name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; python3 -m pip install --user uv==0.11.32 && python3 -m uv sync --locked && echo '✅ Environment synced from uv.lock'

postAttachCommand.server: python3 -m uv run --locked streamlit run app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
